## Compile stuff

```{r}
player_stats_all = dplyr::bind_rows(results_2025, results_2024, results_2023, results_2022, results_2021, results_2020, results_2019, results_2018)
results_team_all = dplyr::bind_rows(results_team_2025, results_team_2024, results_team_2023, results_team_2022, results_team_2021, results_team_2020, results_team_2019, results_team_2018)

```


```{r}
file_path = r"(C:\Users\mrjay\python\jupyter_notebooks\Projects\brownlow\data)"
write.csv(player_stats_all, paste0(file_path, r"(\player_stats_2018_2025_fitzroy.csv)"))

weird_nested_list_cols = c("homeTeamScore.periodScore", "awayTeamScore.periodScore", "matchClock.periods")
write.csv(results_team_all %>% dplyr::select(-weird_nested_list_cols), paste0(file_path, r"(\team_stats_2018_2025_fitzroy.csv)")) # drop the weird nested list
write.csv(player_brownlow_all, paste0(file_path, r"(\brownlow_stats_2018_2024_fitzroy.csv)"))
```
